name: HTTP (RED metrics from spans)
description: Rate, errors and duration of server spans, per route and status code.

panels.title: Rate (req/s)
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server | stats rate() by service span auto

panels.title: Errors (req/s)
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server and status:error | stats rate() by service span auto

panels.title: Duration
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server | stats p50(duration), p95(duration), p99(duration) span auto

panels.title: Routes
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server | stats count(), p95(duration) by http.route | sort count desc | limit 20

panels.title: Status codes
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server | top 10 http.response.status_code

panels.title: Errored requests
panels.query: source spans | service:$service and kind:server and status:error
